texts: The field is quiet, but every card still carries a possibility.
A careful duelist watches the board before committing to a line.
The next decision may shape the entire duel.
Even silence reveals what the visible field is asking for.
The duel waits for a choice grounded in the cards already shown.
A patient hand can turn uncertainty into an opening.
The field remembers every resolved action.
Look closely: defense and attack are both forms of intent.
No hidden card is known until the duel reveals it.
The next move belongs to the duelist who reads the moment.
